MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The small imperial screws and flat-head metric fasteners complement my existing hardware by adding thread sizes and flush-mounting options for repair and fabrication projects.",
    "The clamp meter fits my interest in practical troubleshooting tools, while disposable gloves would help with messy workshop work, provided they are suitable for the materials involved."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another endoscope feels redundant because I already have a triple-lens model, and the recommended one gives me no clear reason to replace it.",
    "The six-inch cutting wheels resemble something I use, but my recent wheels were five inches, so compatibility matters more than their shared purpose.",
    "Breadboards and a decibel meter require projects I do not currently have; the masks and household trash can also do not address my current repair and fabrication needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Having bought inspection and measurement tools seems to be treated as a reason to want more instruments, even when I have no task for them or already own a suitable tool.",
    "Broad workshop associations seem to carry too much weight when the actual fit depends on dimensions, fastening requirements, and a specific use."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated hardware purchases suggest I value complementary thread sizes and head styles, rather than simply wanting more of every fastener assortment.",
    "My recent fastening, cutting, and fabrication purchases give stronger reasons for useful project supplies than for unrelated electronics or household items.",
    "Existing equipment and exact specifications matter: a replacement needs a clear benefit, and consumables need to fit the tools I already use."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my practical workshop interests but sometimes miss the project purpose, compatibility, and complementary function that make an item useful to me now."
}
